description:
There's no mistaking the lineage of this bold, chiseled electric bike. Every line, curve, and angle has been inspired to evoke the sixty years of power and performance excellence you've come to expect from a Ford Mustang, America's best-selling sports car^.
The Mustang electric bike generates 500W* of electric boost that easily accelerates to 32 KM/H** (in pedal assist, Class 3 mode with the rider pedaling) with plenty of torque on-demand.
The eBike features the iconic Mustang LED Sequential Taillights and an integrated one-piece cockpit cradles a full color display with telemetry graphics inspired by Ford's digital infotainment system.
Designed for the street and tuned for fast rides with semi-slick Pirelli Angel tires and dual suspension designed to keep the bike firmly planted over surface imperfections.
Powered by a 48V, 15Ah | 720Wh battery, the Mustang electric bike can cruise up to 100 KM ***, and riders can take advantage of four power power modes – Eco, Normal, Sport, and Track.

e_vehicle_motor.description: 500W* Motor with four modes: Eco, Normal, Sport, and Track
